subject: Post-call follow-up: embedding + structured-output reliability scoping
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Eva Moreno <eva@acme-ai.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call follow-up: embedding + structured-output reliability scoping

Hi Eva & Raj,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. I wanted to capture a concise recap and clear next steps so we can keep momentum for the PoC. Below are the items we agreed on and a few clarifying questions: 

Recap (from our call)
- Goal: Replace current retrieval pipeline with a single embedding + reranker flow and ensure deterministic structured outputs for top-K results (JSON records) used by downstream services.
- Scale target: 100k queries/day in pilot, burst to 400k/day if successful.
- SLO: 95th pct latency <= 300ms for in-region requests; end-to-end validation and retry for schema violations.

Open questions we flagged
1) Schema: you mentioned two primary record types (article_summary and policy_extract) — can you confirm required vs optional fields and maximum array lengths? I've attached a starting sample schema (sample-output-schema.json).
2) Auth & routing: will the PoC run inside your VPC (private deployment) or over our hosted API? If private, we'll prioritize VPC peering and a short auth token rotation approach.
3) Reranker: are you planning to use a separate reranker model or an integrated scorer in the embedder pipeline? Any constraints on model size / quantization?

Next steps (agreed)
- Acme: send final schema contract (fields & required flags) and a short snippet of current retrieval latency profile (end-to-end). Action: Raj (by 4/13).
- Redwood: Aaron/Marcus to outline a constrained-decoding + validation + retry pattern we recommend for JSON outputs, and provide a minimal SDK example for validation hooks. Action: Marcus (by 4/14).
- Schedule: Plan a 60-min PoC kickoff next week once schema confirmed. Mina to propose windows.

Attachments: 1) integration-questions.pdf — list of integration checkpoints and sample telemetry we'll ask for. 2) sample-output-schema.json — starter schema we discussed.

If anything above is off, tell me and I’ll adjust. Otherwise I’ll ping with proposed kickoff slots tomorrow.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-ai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eva Moreno <eva@acme-ai.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call follow-up: embedding + structured-output reliability scoping

Thanks Mina — solid notes. Quick answers below.

Schema: attaching a short doc in-line here with required/optional flags (excerpt). We'll upload a fuller schema to the shared drive later. For now: article_summary requires id, title, summary_text; optional tags[], related_ids[] (max 10). policy_extract requires id, clause_text, source_doc, confidence_score.

Routing/Auth: We'll start with hosted API for speed of iteration (we can move to VPC later). We need token rotation and IP allowlist.

Reranker: We prefer a 2-stage approach: embeddings for recall + lightweight reranker scoring top-100. The reranker must be sub-7B and quantized is fine.

Latency profile: baseline 95th = 220ms for retrieval + app logic (no ML inference). We'll export a small CSV later.

For the kickoff, Tuesday 4/15 10-11am PT or Thursday 4/17 2-3pm PT work for us.

Thanks,
Raj
